host._EDIT_palette: Quality pass (20 Nov, Bio · Build · M1b host quality): swatch ΔE00 worst over normal+deut+prot+trit (de.py). body #F5EBFF 17.7 (endo, trit) — kept: target ivory #F4EBDD is 17.1 normal but 7.0 vs hypo under deut, so the ivory look comes from the warm inner glow + lamp, not the albedo. shawl #5E0F1A 19.0 (accent, trit) — deep wine per G-Art R3 (v2 #761424 read salmon); target #7A1F2B is 13.9 under trit. shawl_dark 20.7. embroidery thread = body pearl (17.7). Feature colours (brow, iris, glasses, gold, sclera, lip) are small features, logged not gated. Rendered-pixel check: `python m1b.py palette` (probe masks).
host._EDIT_palette_R5: G-Art R5 (21 Nov, D-051): shawl #5E0F1A rendered brown under the warm key → #6E1024 (swatch 16.8 vs accent, trit; still ≥ 15). Book cover #4E3222 read as a black slab → #6A4630 lighter leather (11.2 vs accent: props are logged, not gated).

line.en: What if a flat disc had to build a whole body?
line.hi: अगर एक चपटी डिस्क को पूरा शरीर बनाना पड़े तो?
line.hi_note: HI track reuses the EN audio for this sample (caption-only test); a Hindi voice is a later step (script-first, D-032).

video._EDIT_shots: Two angles, same identity. Cut lands on a word boundary near the middle (cuts every 1–3 s, D-032).
video.version_note: v6 = M1b host results fixes (D-051): two-pass loudness (−14 LUFS, TP ≤ −1.5), ink outline on the body (figure/ground vs the real plate), lamp B moved off the crown, wide eyes from the lid caps (no eye scaling), per-clip manifests. Look otherwise = v5 (quality R4).
video._EDIT_hook: Hook ≤ 1 s: surprised face + book snaps open (blank pages) at 0.05–0.25 s.

grade._EDIT: compositor grade (visual-style §5: warm on plate/light; host keeps its own pass)
grade._EDIT_bloom: threshold 2.0 = only the lamp/bokeh emitters bloom (target 8)

captions._EDIT: visual-style §1: captions band 55–65 % from top, max width 70 %, ≤ 2 lines, ≤ 28 chars/line, cap height ≥ 40 px at 1080, weight ≥ 600, scrim ≥ 4.5:1, Devanagari +15 %.
captions._EDIT_tracks: EN and HI ship as separate caption tracks / renders (G-A11y R1), never switched mid-shot.
captions._EDIT_scrim: 0.92 = worst case over the brightest pearl pixel: white ≥ 8:1, key ≥ 5:1 (measured by m1b.py qa on rendered frames; 0.75 gave 3.5:1 / 2.2:1).

audio._EDIT: H6 + D-051: two-pass loudnorm (loud.py) → −14 LUFS ±0.5 and true peak ≤ −1.5 dBTP, measured on every encoded mp4. Limiter ceiling = tp − limiter_margin_db (room for AAC overshoot).

encode._EDIT: x264 beat Pascal NVENC on size at 720p (D-045); h264_nvenc is the --nvenc option

face._EDIT_R5: G-Art R5: body read matte porcelain → rougher 0.36→0.26, coat 0.32→0.18 for a glassier sheen. Watch the crown hot spot in shot B.

plate._EDIT_bokeh: Owner 21 Nov: 8-sided (near-round lens shape, not cells), dimmer, top corners only.
plate._EDIT_lampB: D-051: v5 lamp B shade sat behind the crown (light on light). Moved further out and up: fx −0.97, fy 0.74.

quality._EDIT_R4: G-Art R4 (21 Nov 03:45): book z −0.31/tilt −42 (mouth visible, page tops show), arms 0.046/hands ×1.35, glasses_z 0.066 (looks over rims), coat/body rough up (crown hot spot), glow_top 0.28, shawl spec 0 + top 0.26/−0.06 + open 30°, shade_emit 1.2, bokeh 2.5 + size 0.03–0.06, lamps pushed out of her silhouette, cameras 3.3.
